newsitem.title: USA: Fusion sees Q4 EPS beating Street range.
newsitem.headline: Fusion sees Q4 EPS beating Street range.

text.p: Fusion Systems Corp Friday reported fourth-quarter net revenues of $18.4 million and said strong bookings in the period should allow it to report earnings well above the Street's range of $0.15-0.19 per share.

The supplier of front-end process equipment to the semiconductor industry said revenues from continuing operations for the year were $84.6 million, up 45 percent over the prior year. Fusion also noted that it had strong bookings in the fourth quarter, resulting in a year-end backlog of about $39 million.

"After disappointing third quarter results, we are delighted to announce strong fourth quarter and year-end results for 1996," said Leslie Levine, president and chief executive officer of Fusion. The company said fourth-quarter net revenues rose 14 percent from the third quarter.

"Furthermore, with our strong backlog and the continued acceptance of our new products, we currently feel confident that we can continue to outperform the general semiconductor equipment market as well as Street expectations, in 1997."
The company will release full financial results for the fourth quarter and year-end 1996 on February 13, 1997.
